idle_connection_memory.note: resident-set-size delta while the bounded listener keeps loopback idle connections admitted

http2_stream_memory.note: resident-set-size delta while the proxy keeps a single downstream HTTP/2 connection busy with concurrent delayed upstream streams

assumptions: loopback-only proxy measurements; these numbers are for relative regression detection and local capacity planning, not internet-facing SLA claims
resident-set-size sampling is process-level and most comparable across commits on the same host class
TLS overhead is measured against the same HTTP/1 batch through a local Rustls-terminated downstream connection
